# Kernel command line shared by every boot profile.
# One or more parameters per line; lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# post-image.sh joins the lines and appends root=PARTLABEL=... itself.

# Root filesystem: read-only EROFS, wait for the NVMe device to appear.
rootfstype=erofs ro rootwait

# Consoles: the screen first, the serial port last so that it becomes
# /dev/console (systemd messages and the QEMU serial console).
console=tty0 console=ttyS0,115200n8

# Keep the boot log readable; raise it when debugging.
loglevel=4
